_note: Config for emit_summit_matrix.py + emit_evolution.py — the SUMMIT side of estMatrix for NVDA. ANNUAL only: the model's quarterly grid is sparse/misaligned, and the dataset's Quarterly view carries no summit series, so views.q is empty. Metric keys match js/results-data/nvda.js. lastActual established from the data: the 2025-12-12 file still projects FY2026 (not yet closed) so its y-lastActual is 2025; the Mar/May 2026 files carry FY2026 reported.
_sign_note: The model carries capex as negative cash flow; the dataset shows positive spend.
_evolution_note: Feeds emit_evolution.py — the Estimates pane. Annual, every year (forward or reported) to show how the model's view of each year moved across the three snapshots. cons_metrics = the BBG figure the model stores inside its own snapshot (best provenance, same save date). prior = FY2025, the year before years[0], for the first year's implied growth on revenue.
